title: What Is a Bitcoin Mining Rig Life Span?
hook: How long does a Bitcoin mining machine last?

scenes.narration: A rough planning figure is three to five years, and that is not a warranty.
It can be much shorter if electricity or difficulty rises, or newer machines are more efficient.
A machine can be online yet economically obsolete.

cta: How old is your rig? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
description_body: Three to five years is a rough physical range. Economics can end it sooner.
